results.title: Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells and Wnt Pathway ...
results.content: Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells and Wnt Pathway Modulation: A Novel Therapy for Liver Cirrhosis and Steatosis | Tissue Engineering and Regenerative Medicine | Springer Nature Link. Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells and Wnt Pathway Modulation: A Novel Therapy for Liver Cirrhosis and Steatosis. Human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cell-exosomal miR-627-5p ameliorates non-alcoholic fatty liver disease by repressing FTO expression. Human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells ameliorate liver fibrosis by improving mitochondrial function via Slc25a47-Sirt3 signaling pathway. Human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells-derived exosomes alleviate liver fibrosis through the Wnt/β-catenin pathway. _et al._ Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells and Wnt Pathway Modulation: A Novel Therapy for Liver Cirrhosis and Steatosis.
